recognize_zh: CD3 在多數中小型淋巴球呈強膜狀陽性，密集分布於浸潤中，其間夾雜未染色的較大細胞與組織球，顯示 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍中豐富的背景反應性 T 細胞。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Dense, diffuse distribution of T cells throughout the field
Interspersed unstained larger cells and histiocytes with pale blue nuclei
No sheets of CD3-negative large cells in this field
describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights a dense population of small to medium-sized T cells distributed diffusely throughout the infiltrate. Scattered larger CD3-negative cells and histiocytes are interspersed among the positive cells. The T cells represent the reactive background component (reported as CD8-predominant) of an EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer, in which the large atypical cells are B cells.

ddx.vs: Would show cytologically atypical CD3+ cells, often with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than bland reactive T cells around CD20+ large cells.
Also T-cell rich, but lacks the ulcerative circumscribed lesion and EBER positivity and has few scattered large B cells.
Positive cells are atypical, cytoplasmic CD3ε+/CD56+ and EBER+, with angiodestruction and necrosis.
